name: Omatsuri Yarou
source:
In this short game, Sawamura narrates a memory of when he returns to his hometown for a local festival called Loincloth Festival. But, after meeting an old friend, a memory from a deeper past is revived.

[From F95zone]
translation:
这部短篇游戏中，泽村讲述自己回故乡参加当地“兜裆布祭”的回忆。但遇见老朋友后，更久远的记忆被重新唤醒。

[来源：F95zone]
